$schema: X.KF.W9 escalation-trigger register (G-KFW9-12 publishes; G-KFW9-13 closes)
recordCountDerivation: each trigger homed at the bank by grep -l over registry/adjudicated/kf-*.md, then the decisive line read. Twelve distinct records because (5)+(10) share kf-KeyframesAddDialog and (7)+(13)'s KF-TFP-19 limb share kf-TimingFunctionPanel, while (13)'s other limb (L-M-10/N-3 at kf-KeyframesStringControls) supplies the twelfth.
law: No trigger closes by inference; each names its measurement. An unrun trigger is reported PROVISIONAL at close with its exact unmet precondition, never silently inherited (G-KFW9-13). The write-back is an APPEND-ONLY dated ADDENDUM under the ORIGINAL banked id, by seat .e ALONE (E-1 immutable bytes / E-3 addenda-not-patch). An addendum that edits an existing line, mints a new id, or lands from any other seat is a bounds expansion -> S-13 triumvirate.

baselineAtPublication.measuredBy: grep -rl 'PROVISIONAL' kf-*.md | wc -l  ·  grep -rl 'ADDENDUM.*2026-09-17' kf-*.md | wc -l

triggers.measurement: the modal punch-through observed on the z-modal surface
triggers.discriminator: the contenteditable sets no spellcheck=false / autocorrect=off / autocapitalize=off (:41-50). On iOS, autocorrect and autocapitalize REWRITE THE TEXT BEFORE @input READS IT — the tell is a mutated value, not a desktop red squiggle.
triggers.falsifier: text that survives an iOS entry byte-identical kills the compounding claim against KF-KC-16/17

triggers.measurement: steps(1, jump-none) reached through the shipped step-start seed inside the glass-ui EasingPicker the scene mounts by default; decides L-i2's ordering
triggers.discriminator: the throw must land in the RENDER path (the easingFn computed feeds both the picker's value computed AND its emit watcher — render and emit both fault), not merely in an event handler
triggers.falsifier: a rendered picker that degrades without throwing collapses the row to its banked MAJOR
triggers.note: GLASS-OWNED cure (BH relay); value.js is CSS-spec-correct. This wave measures and authors no producer byte. The EasingSidebar.md:41 KF-ES-3 is a DIFFERENT limb (smooth-step-3 polarity) and is not this trigger.

triggers.measurement: SS-13 residue #1 must log getPropertyValue AND ctx.fillStyle to pick the branch
triggers.discriminator: BOTH values logged together. (a) parser rejects light-dark() -> every assignment a silent no-op, 400 opaque black rects -> BLOCKER. (b) parser resolves light-dark() against the canvas's used color-scheme -> the :270 repaint is what re-tints. (c) css-values-5 arbitrary substitution -> getPropertyValue returns the resolved arm and D's byte-identity premise dies. Logging ONE value cannot pick a branch; a third such pass HALTS (S-13).
triggers.falsifier: any branch other than (a) forecloses the BLOCKER

triggers.measurement: ONE armed row, ONE measurement, TWO banked ids — deltaY: 0 joint MAJOR and the label collision. Both ids receive the addendum; neither is renamed, merged or dropped.
triggers.discriminator: a wheel event with deltaY EXACTLY 0 (not merely small) reaching the track handler; and, in the same capture, the label collision at the rendered overlap
triggers.falsifier: a handler filtering deltaY === 0 before acting kills the joint MAJOR; labels that reflow rather than collide kill D-4
triggers.note: this row's two-ids-one-trigger composition is why the register's figure is THIRTEEN and not fourteen (R2-15)

triggers.discriminator: read inside each engine cell SEPARATELY — I-20 applies in full; a webkit-engine reading may NOT be written into a safari-app column. Three separate rows.
triggers.falsifier: a tabIndex reachable and consistent across the three engine cells forecloses the escalation

triggers.measurement: the @starting-style entry transition's rendered first frame, STAMPED (KF-AX-4)
triggers.discriminator: an un-stamped frame cannot be placed in the entry sequence and does not discriminate
triggers.falsifier: an entry that renders its start value (rather than skipping to the end) forecloses all three
triggers.note: the data-allow-motion producer-inert policy is decided ONCE demo-wide (KF-SST-13, third witness; S-3), not re-decided here

triggers.measurement: the observation taken THROUGH KF-CO-5's path
triggers.discriminator: a reading taken off the direct path does not carry the escalation
triggers.falsifier: the path measured inert forecloses the promotion

triggers.measurement: ONE performance.measure — the cheapest trigger in the register
triggers.discriminator: the measure must be taken on the lane the SUBSTRATE actually runs. The TypingDots INVERSION is live: at the disqualified 8281638c the dots stop (rAF lane); at origin/master they keep pulsing (WAAPI lane). A measure on the wrong lane answers a different question. Substrate stamp 55e9bf0d is mandatory on this row.
triggers.falsifier: a cost below the felt threshold pins the row INFO-forever; above it, the row promotes

triggers.discriminator: an ACTUAL counterexample instance, not an argument that one could exist
triggers.falsifier: absence across the captured band leaves the grade where it stands — absence is recorded as absence, never as a green

triggers.measurement: the autocapitalize/autocorrect mutation inside pre[contenteditable] on a REAL iOS device (G-KFW9-11's own close condition)
triggers.discriminator: a desktop cell cannot revive this MAJOR — the mutation is an iOS text-entry behaviour
triggers.falsifier: no mutation on real iOS keeps R-A's MAJOR dead
triggers.note: governed by the KF-AV-28 standing supersession rider — the witness is lawful now; a CURE is not this wave's to spend

triggers.measurement: the dark-arm contrast numeral, RE-DERIVED AT CAPTURE (KF-SKEL-22 — no corpus numeral is the figure of record)
triggers.discriminator: the DARK arm specifically; a light-arm reading does not decide it
triggers.falsifier: a dark-arm numeral above the threshold forecloses the contest
triggers.note: kf-EasingTarget's KF-ET-24 is a SEPARATE row and a named TRAP (NEGATIVE-REGISTER T-3) — do not conflate

triggers.measurement: the BITE POINT — the viewport height at which clipping begins. The rail wrapper at :55 carries no shrink-0 while :33/:134/:9 do, so the column can compress on that one member to min-content; below it, justify-center + overflow-hidden (not auto) clip both ends symmetrically with no scroll affordance and no recovery.
triggers.discriminator: the bite point itself; a reading that only confirms 'it clips eventually' does not separate MINOR from MAJOR
triggers.falsifier: a bite point outside any reachable viewport keeps the row MINOR
triggers.note: the cheapest probe in that record (residue #10)

triggers.measurement: a FELT INP cost — not the existence of the waste, which is already banked. KSC: N+1 prettier formats per typing pause + per-pause localStorage serialize. TFP: per-pointermove whole-bucket JSON.stringify + localStorage.setItem on the demo's only direct-manipulation authoring surface, no debounce anywhere on the path.
triggers.discriminator: INP (the interaction's own latency), not total work. Both rows are graded on the kf-ChannelControls precedent — 'runs and does nothing' != breakage; recurring waste on a debounced path books MINOR until SS-13 measures a FELT cost. A CPU-time figure alone promotes neither row.
triggers.falsifier: an INP inside the good threshold pins both at MINOR and retires the hooks
